diagnosis.narrative: The series carries a strong long-run trend. Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The spectrum is close to white noise, so most of the variation is irregular and hard to predict. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.205), which favours a robust combination.

Series context: trend strength 0.9991 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.205); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.828.
